claim.zh: 16FFC MRAM 完成可靠性驗證並具生產準備；不等同量產。
claim.en: 16FFC MRAM completed reliability qualification and was production-ready; this does not establish volume production.

claim.zh: 2022 年報提出 2023 車用 Grade 1 目標；後續完成事件另列於 2023。
claim.en: The 2022 report targeted automotive Grade 1 for 2023; the subsequent completion is recorded separately under 2023.

claim.zh: 研發章記錄 22nm 消費級 MRAM 已量產。
claim.en: The R&D chapter records 22nm consumer-grade MRAM in volume production.

claim.zh: 16nm 消費級技術資格完成。
claim.en: 16nm consumer-grade technology qualification was completed.

claim.zh: 下一代較小位元持續開發。
claim.en: Development of the next generation with smaller bits continued.

claim.zh: 40／28／22nm 已量產；22／28ULL 為第二年量產。
claim.en: 40/28/22nm was in volume production; 22/28ULL was in its second year of volume production.

claim.zh: 12nm 與下一代 RRAM 仍在開發。
claim.en: 12nm and next-generation RRAM remained in development.

claim.zh: 較小位元的 16nm 車用資格目標為 2025；第二代完成紀錄另列於 2025。
claim.en: Automotive qualification of smaller-bit 16nm was targeted for 2025; second-generation completion is recorded separately under 2025.

claim.zh: 12nm 與 5nm MRAM 進入開發。
claim.en: 12nm and 5nm MRAM entered development.

claim.zh: 年報研發章記錄 12nm 消費級技術資格完成。
claim.en: The R&D chapter records completed 12nm consumer-grade technology qualification.

claim.zh: 6nm RRAM 進入開發。
claim.en: 6nm RRAM entered development.

claim.zh: 可供原型設計，初步巨集設計套件已可用。
claim.en: Available for prototyping, with a preliminary macro design kit available.

claim.zh: N12e 通過供生產的消費級資格。
claim.en: N12e completed consumer-grade qualification for production.

claim.zh: 22RRAM 完成十萬次循環資格驗證。
claim.en: 22RRAM completed qualification for one hundred thousand cycles.

claim.zh: 22ULL RRAM 通過車用 Grade 1 要求。
claim.en: 22ULL RRAM met automotive Grade 1 requirements.

claim.zh: 3 月公告 Grade 1 ready 且 PDK 可用，可進行原型設計。
claim.en: The March announcement states Grade 1 ready and PDK availability for prototyping.

claim.zh: 德勒斯登量產目標為 2026 下半年；本次未取得完成公告。
claim.en: Dresden volume production is targeted for the second half of 2026; this review has no completion announcement.

claim.zh: 查核日的官方產品索引正文列 22／16nm 已完成車規並生產。
claim.en: Official indexed product text observed on the verification date lists 22/16nm as automotive-qualified and in production.

claim.zh: 12nm 車用與 5nm 高寫速 MRAM 仍在開發。
claim.en: 12nm automotive and 5nm high-write-speed MRAM remain in development.

claim.zh: 查核日的官方產品索引正文列 40／28／22／12nm RRAM 大量生產。
claim.en: Official indexed product text observed on the verification date lists 40/28/22/12nm RRAM in volume production.

claim.zh: 6nm RRAM 仍在開發。
claim.en: 6nm RRAM remains in development.
